description: Fetch markets, lines, outcomes, and live odds for one event_id on a bookmaker. Start with names_only=true to learn the market names, then request one name with market= or narrow with q=. view=all adds native markets (canonical: false) and needs market= or q=. Each outcome carries a key for mbc_resolve_picks. Spends 1 work unit per call against the daily cap. Costs 0 credits.

market.description: Full market name (exact, case-insensitive) or a substring. Repeat it to request several names.

names_only.description: Return the names only, with no outcomes or prices. The list is complete, not capped.

q.description: Substring match against every canonical and native market name.

view.description: canonical (default) or all. all requires market= or q=.

name: mbc_get_event_markets
title: Get All Markets & Odds for an Event
